rules: Keep provenance-branded IDs; no implicit cast between M/T/R/P/report/job/peer/cmid/mid/packetId.
Require explicit runtime callbacks for R->P and confirmation->record; fail closed when unavailable.
Validate positive safe integer App HTTP IDs before producing JSON; preserve BOSS int64 as bigint/decimal strings in an actual protocol adapter rather than unsafe Number roundtrip.
Reject duplicate pending IDs before explicit batch; source UI snapshot may send duplicate rows, so this is stricter design.
Require connected and explicit user caller action for IM send; never make ACK/read/delivery followups automatic side effects of AI content.
Match ACK packetId AND ACK.cmid to original publish before reporting correlated send confirmation; source lacks the latter equality guard.
Do not treat SSE EOF, HTTP200, ordinary accepted code4/200, ADD_FRIEND, socket send, PUBACK, and read receipt as one success flag.

outcome_layers.app_rule: Transport HTTP success alone is not task/delivery/IM success. Ordinary numeric 401 rejected first; raw preserved.
main logical DONE only in fallback after known event branches; EOF alone does not prove task succeeded.
task/list and result/list are independent REST reads; source joins task to M, but no verified R->pending edge.
Read receipt only; cannot be used as pending creation or confirmation.

Fmt requires exact raw.code===0 AND raw.result.status in ADD_FRIEND,DELIVERED. ADD_FRIEND is accepted by UI without proving attachment receipt. Stops batch on first error; no automatic IM navigation/send.
listByJobIds status is server observation keyed by jobSnapshot.jobId; FAILED/statusMessage used for failure UI. Not BOSS ACK.
ensureSdkReady initiates connect; ready is not CONNACK. UI text send explicitly needs connected.
packetId correlates PUBLISH; only remainingLength18 decodes cmid/mid extension. Plain PUBACK cannot finish high-level delivery callback.

lc clears timer by truthy ACK.cmid and emits original message with mid=ACK.mid, but lacks cmid equality guard; UI only marks status1 by original cmid. 60s timeout emits send-error, page handler is empty.
Separate messageRead event marks READ2; status1/ACK is not read or confirmation of resume attachment.
